Commander matcher

Rate commanders love / like / dislike / hate (like and dislike count half as much) and the list re-ranks. Scores come from EDHREC tags, color identity, bracket mix, AI-written play-style ratings (guesses), and, for commanders with 200+ decks, features measured from EDHREC's average decklist (ramp, removal, draw counts and so on) plus a short play-style label written by an AI reading that list. The playstyle weight slider sets how much those last two count; on a 7-commander test they did not beat the older tags-only model.

two commanders at a time; picking one counts as a like for it and a dislike for the other
